policy: Project license GPL-3.0-or-later; dependencies must be GPLv3-compatible (scripts/license_policy.py)
notes: exceptions: Owner-granted, dated waivers for dependencies whose license is incompatible with GPLv3 or needs review. Honored only by `audit_tauri_host_licenses.py --mode l3` (listed as warnings); `--mode distribution` ignores them and fails. An exception matches on ecosystem + name + the exact license string (plus `version` if the entry pins one), so a license change lapses it.

license_file_reviews: reviewed classification of a dependency that publishes no SPDX `license` field but ships a license file. Pinned to ecosystem + name + version + license_file + SHA-256 of that file; any change returns the package to needs_review. Honored in both modes because it is a reviewed classification of the actual license text, not a waiver; reviewed_by and reviewed_on are required.
license_ref_allowlist: `LicenseRef-*` identifiers that have been reviewed as GPLv3-compatible. Empty means every LicenseRef is incompatible.

license_file_reviews.name: hdf5-metno-src
license_file_reviews.reason: The crate's Cargo.toml has no `license` field; the bundled HDF5 LICENSE states "This software library and utilities is covered by the 3-clause BSD License" and adds the LBNL-style enhancements clause (voluntarily shared enhancements are licensed back to the authors), which grants rather than restricts; SPDX BSD-3-Clause-LBNL, GPLv3-compatible.
license_file_reviews.note: Distribution obligation: the LICENSE also carries Lawrence Berkeley and UC LLNL support notices that must be retained in any redistribution of source, binaries and documentation; carry the full HDF5 LICENSE in the third-party notices.
